'''Jonmor Tinto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tinto was employed by a [[Bank/Legends|Bank]] situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], but after Tinto illicitly embezzled funds from the bank, he was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following his release, Tinto and several other former convicts established a small colony on the planet [[Longwind]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], though he later left the settlement and journeyed to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, a Humbarine industrialist held a grudge against Tinto as a result of an outstanding debt that the accountant owed and placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 127,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Tinto's capture. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] subsequently tracked down Tinto on Nar Shaddaa and apprehended him, permanently disabling the accountant in the process. Cradossk later mentioned his capture of Tinto within his autobiography ''[[Making a Killing]]''.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
